content.short: PWN enables peer-to-peer, fixed-duration loans of fungible tokens backed by fungible or non-fungible assets, with lenders earning interest.
content.description: PWN is a peer-to-peer lending protocol for long-term, mortgage-like loans of digital assets, backed by other digital assets. Borrowers can obtain fixed-duration loans of fungible tokens that are backed by fungible or non-fungible tokens, while lenders earn interest by providing these loans. The protocol is trustless and immutable, does not rely on external oracles, and does not employ protocol-managed liquidations. It is deployed on Ethereum, Polygon, Cronos, Base and Mantle.
